name: is-tax-overview
description: A one-page map of the Icelandic tax system for tax year 2026, from the Income Tax Act 90/2003, the VAT Act 50/1988 and Acts 4/1995, 113/1990 and 129/1997 as consolidated on althingi.is (text 158a), Advertisement 1521/2025 and Skatturinn's 2026 pages and filing notices. Covers the income year, the authority, who is taxed on worldwide income, the 2026 withholding bands (31.49% / 37.99% / 46.29%), the personal credit, the 22% capital income tax, company tax at 20% and 37.6%, the 6.35% payroll levy, the 15.5% minimum pension contribution, VAT at 24% and 11% with the ISK 2,000,000 registration limit, and the main 2026 deadlines (company returns 31 May, professional extension to 21 September). Use for 'how does tax work in Iceland', 'Iceland tax overview', 'Iceland tax rates 2026'. It points to the pack's domain skills for the detail: iceland-income-tax, is-corporate-income-tax, iceland-vat, iceland-payroll, iceland-social-contributions, is-cross-border, is-transfer-pricing, is-company-forma
